verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis II mission launched from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Artemis II crewed lunar mission launches from Pad 39B at Kennedy Space Center in Cape Canaveral, Florida'; R3: 'Launch site Kennedy, LC-39B'; R5: 'Artemis II lifted off from Launch Pad 39B at Kennedy Space Center'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the launch from LC-39B at Kennedy Space Center, Florida.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission lifted off on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Artemis II crew lifted off at 6:35 p.m. ET from the Kennedy Space Center... on April 1, 2026'; R3: 'April 1, 2026, 22:35:12 UTC (6:35:12 p.m. EDT)'; R5: 'lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT from Kennedy Space Center’s Launch Complex 39B... April 1, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Exact date and time match across sources.
